title: Two Sample Sizes in Test-Time LLM Ensembling: Buffered ERM and Minimax Theory
abstract: arXiv:2610.21363v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time scaling can improve the performance of large language models by generating multiple answers to a question and aggregating them. Weighted ensembles extend this idea by drawing answers from several models, with the weights determining how often each model is used. Learning these weights from a training dataset involves two sample sizes: $Q$ labeled questions and $N$ generations per model and question. We study their interplay through the clean risk, the population error of the ensemble's infinite-generation voting rule. Under a margin condition with exponent $\beta$, we show that empirical risk minimization (ERM) with a calibrated margin buffer achieves excess risk of order $Q^{-1/2}+N^{-\beta/2}$, up to logarithmic factors, for fixed numbers of models and candidate answers. translated_title: 测试时大语言模型集成中的两个样本量：缓冲经验风险最小化与极小极大理论
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展可以通过为一个问题生成多个答案并对其进行聚合来提升大语言模型的性能。加权集成进一步拓展了这一思想，即从多个模型中抽取答案，其中权重决定了每个模型被使用的频率。从训练数据集中学习这些权重涉及两个样本量：Q 个带标注的问题，以及每个模型对每个问题进行的 N 次生成。我们通过干净风险来研究这两个样本量之间的相互作用，干净风险即该集成在无限次生成下的投票规则的总体误差。在指数为 β 的间隔条件下，我们证明带有校准间隔缓冲的经验风险最小化（ERM）方法，在模型数量和候选答案数量固定的情况下，可以达到量级为 Q^{-1/2} + N^{-β/2} 的超额风险（仅相差对数因子）。为了探究这种对 Q 和 N 的依赖关系是否最优，我们分析了一个简化的子模型，该模型包含两个模型且每个问题只有两个可能的答案。我们……
tldr: 该论文研究了测试时大语言模型加权集成中标注问题数 Q 与每问题生成数 N 这两个样本量的相互作用，证明带校准间隔缓冲的 ERM 可达到 Q^{-1/2}+N^{-β/2} 阶的超额风险，并通过简化的双模型子模型分析验证了该风险率的最优性。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the interplay between two sample sizes—Q labeled questions and N generations per model and question—in test-time weighted LLM ensembling, proving that buffered ERM achieves excess risk of order Q^{-1/2}+N^{-β/2} and establishing its optimality through minimax analysis of a simplified two-model submodel.
